title: Thirty years, 19 moments
lede: From one store in Quincy to the No. 2 toy chain in America, and from a failed sale to an empty castle. Filter by thread.

events.title: Founded
events.text: Sid Shneider and Joseph Arnesano found Child World in Quincy, Massachusetts.

events.title: Cole National buys it
events.text: Child World is then second only to Toys “R” Us among toy supermarkets.

events.title: KKR takes Cole private
events.text: Child World’s parent goes through a leveraged buyout.

events.title: 18% floated
events.text: Cole sells 18% of Child World to the public; the chain has more than 100 stores in 21 states.

events.title: CNC Holding
events.text: Jeffrey Cole’s group takes on more debt to regain control of the parent.

events.title: For sale
events.text: CNC begins trying to sell Child World.

events.title: Trefoil’s offer
events.text: Roy Disney’s Trefoil offers debt securities for CNC’s 82% and $14 a share for the public’s 18%.

events.title: Torrance
events.text: A prototype store opens in Torrance, the first of up to 20 planned in California.

events.title: Trefoil walks
events.text: The offer is abandoned on Thanksgiving Day; the shares fall to $5 the next day.

events.title: Payments suspended
events.text: A $14.4M third-quarter loss; payments stop on $122M of bank debt and $212M of merchandise.

events.title: The bosses leave
events.text: The chief executive resigns, weeks after the chairman. Mattel and Tyco brace for bad debts.

events.title: Toys “R” Us veterans
events.text: W. John Devine and Ronald Tuchman’s WC Acquisition emerges as the buyer.

events.title: $2 a share
events.text: CNC agrees to sell its 82%; public holders are to get $2 a share.

events.title: 26 stores shut
events.text: Chicago, Houston and Dallas stores and three distribution centers close, taking a $20M charge.

events.title: Chapter 11
events.text: Child World files in White Plains, closing 54 of 125 stores; about 1,500 jobs go.

events.title: Lionel talks
events.text: A merger with Lionel is proposed; otherwise the last 71 stores will close.

events.title: Talks fail
events.text: Child World says it will close its remaining stores.

events.title: Nearly over
events.text: The bankruptcy court records that the closing sales will finish within the month.

events.title: Empty castles
events.text: The Saugus, Massachusetts store stands empty.
